title: Book Two · Chapter 112: Three Minutes
story:
On Friday, Ronan sits in the third row at the reading meeting. His guide stays closed on his knees.

The group with the lost coats stands at the front. Their talk takes the three minutes from his old card. They hold up a small blue coat. A younger girl lifts her hand.

“That is my brother's.”

The room laughs gently. The group has a real answer. The coat goes to the girl's chair.

Ronan presses the guide flat. He knows the lost coat group needs the time. He still wants to stand at the front.

Leo sits beside him.

“Do you want me to hold the guide?” Leo asks.

“No.”

“You keep bending it.”

Ronan loosens his hands. The cover has a new line across one corner.

After the meeting, Leo waits near the stairs.

“Jun told me about Wednesday,” he says.

“Did he tell everyone?”

“He told me because I asked about the book.”

Ronan feels angry with Jun for a moment. Then he remembers Leo's question about the book.

“I am making the corrections.”

“I know. There is a sign at the gate.”

For a moment they watch pupils leave the hall. Mei carries her own folder. She stops beside Ronan.

“Miss Wu told me my picture is right,” she says. “Is my name still only under that?”

“Yes.”

“I want to see the new page.”

“I can show you on Monday.”

She nods and leaves. She does not offer more pictures.

At the gate, a father waits with a small girl. The girl points at Ronan's guide.

“He is the guide boy.”

Ronan stops beside them. The father asks about the room.

“Thursday after lunch this term,” Ronan says. “The old guide has a mistake. May I correct yours?”

The girl takes a folded copy from her bag. It is warm from the sun. Ronan puts it on a low wall and opens it carefully.

The father watches him place the new paper strip.

“Does the route change?”

“No. Jun and I checked the route. But I copied the old opening day. The right day is Thursday this term.”

The father reads the new line and thanks him. They go through the gate.

Leo is still at the stairs. He is waiting for Ronan, but he does not say it.

“Are you coming?” he asks.

Ronan puts away the glue.

“Yes.”

They walk home together. Leo talks about a ball game. Ronan listens. At the first corner, Leo asks him about the score from their last game.

Ronan remembers the last goal. He tells Leo how the ball went past him. Soon they are both laughing about the game.

## 词句提示

row＝排；loosen＝松开；glue＝胶水；score＝比分。

## 理解问题

1. 原来的三分钟给了哪组？
2. Mei希望确认自己的哪项边界？

## 读句子

**Leo / waits / near the stairs.** Leo／在楼梯附近／等着。
